title: Design and synthesis of Osthole-based compounds as potential Nrf2 agonists.
authors: Huang, Weiwei; Huang, Yi; Cui, Jiayan; Wu, Yuhang; Zhu, Fuli; Huang, Jin; Ma, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成蛇床子素类Nrf2激动剂，仅涉及小分子-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: A total of 23 compounds based on Osthole skeleton were designed and synthesized. Their agonistic activity for Nrf2 were evaluated by Dual-luciferase Reporter Gene Assay. Most of the compounds showed better activities compared with Osthole, especially O15 and O21. And the median effective concerntration (EC(50)) values was calculated accordingly, both of which showed remarkable activity for Nrf2. The structure activity relationship study indicated that introduction of the structure of stilbene might be beneficial for enhancement of agonistic properties of Osthole, and the position of the substituent may have a greater effect on the activity than the electron-donating/withdrawing ability of the substituent. Mechanism of the action of selected compound O15 was investigated by molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay and ubiquitination assay, which suggested the reason why O15 exhibited relatively stronger agonistic activity for Nrf2. Compound O15 and O21 both provided novel methods to investigate Osthole-based compounds as Nrf2 agonists.
abstract_zh: 基于Osthole骨架共设计并合成了23种化合物。通过双荧光素酶报告基因实验评估了它们对Nrf2的激动活性。与Osthole相比，大多数化合物表现出更好的活性，尤其是O15和O21。并据此计算了半数有效浓度（EC(50)）值，两者均显示出对Nrf2的显著活性。构效关系研究表明，引入二苯乙烯结构可能有利于增强Osthole的激动特性，且取代基的位置对活性的影响可能大于取代基的供电子/吸电子能力。通过分子对接、细胞热位移实验和泛素化实验研究了选定化合物O15的作用机制，这揭示了O15为何对Nrf2表现出相对较强的激动活性。化合物O15和O21均为研究基于Osthole骨架的Nrf2激动剂提供了新方法。
